notes.title: Introducing the new Gladiator website
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone, 

We are thrilled to announce the release of the official Gladiator Games website. @Benn (Taylor's Version) has been working tirelessly these past few weeks to ensure that the website is perfect.

Here is what to expect:
[h1]1. Stay updated[/h1]
Never miss a beat with regular newsletter releases to ensure that our community can stay up to date on all upcoming project announcements and releases. These newsletters will be used closer to the release of Midnight At Forest (V2). There is also going to be frequent blog releases, these will be accessible through the homepage of the website!

[h1]2. Mobile friendly[/h1]
Been AFK in the community for a while? No worries! The website is compatible with all mobile devices, which means that you can stay on top of everything Gladiator Games related! 

[h1]3. Get Support[/h1]
Need any assistance? Have any unanswered questions about Gladiator Games? You can contact the team through our emails via the website, this will ensure that we can get back to you with a solution ASAP. 


[h2]Head over to https://gladiatorgames.xyz/ and take a look for yourself.[/h2]

Signed,
Kayla,
Marketing Director & PR Manager

notes.title: Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays, and Happy New Year!
notes.notes:
[h1]🎄 Happy Holidays from the Midnight at Forest Team! 🎁[/h1]

Hello everyone!

As the holiday season approaches, we want to take a moment to express our deepest gratitude to each and every one of you for making this year unforgettable. Your passion, feedback, and support have fueled our creative journey, and we couldn't be more thankful.

[h2]🌟 Thank You for an Incredible Year![/h2]

The Midnight at Forest community has grown stronger, and the enthusiasm you've shown for our game has been nothing short of amazing. Whether you've been with us from the beginning or joined recently, your presence has made a significant impact.

Midnight at Forest has over 29,000 downloads in total. Below is a statistics graph from the very start of 2023, to the end of 2023.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41848499/94692a9a307a8ab7e7b0782bb74608d8f1236e21.png[/img]

[h2]🎮 Continuous Work on Midnight at Forest V2[/h2]

We're excited to share that behind the scenes, our dedicated team has been hard at work on Midnight at Forest V2. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we're committed to making the next installment even more immersive, thrilling, and filled with surprises. Expect multiplayer, cosmetics, a fun and scary environment, and of course, the best possible experience for new users.

[h2]🤗 Thank You Once Again[/h2]

As we reflect on the year gone by, we want to express our deepest gratitude. Thank you for being part of the Midnight at Forest community, for your feedback, and for making this game something truly special. We look forward to sharing more adventures with you in the coming year.


[h2]📝 We're continuously looking for people to join the Gladiator Games Team[/h2]

Whether your skills are graphic design, game development, or even discord moderation, we're always looking for people. If you're interested, join our discord and create a ticket if it is not listed in #job-listings!

[b]Website:[/b] https://gladiatorgames.xyz
[b]Discord:[/b] https://discord.gg/nrFSp8VugF

Thank you for everything everyone, have a Happy Holiday, Merry Christmas, and a Happy New Year.

Thanks for reading,
Rayne,
Founder of Gladiator Games.

notes.title: We're looking for Human Resources, QA Testers, and Discord Moderators.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We, at Gladiator Games are looking for people to help us run our company. We need people for all kinds of things. At the moment, nothing will be paid but we can offer payment once we finish our game.
If you're interested in any of these position, you can join our discord (https://discord.gg/nrFSp8VugF) and have a look in the job listings channel, for Human Resources, please check the announcements channel.

If you're interested in any other positions, such as Game Moderators, Programming, Graphics Design, feel free to make a support ticket in the discord!

Thank you everyone,
Rayne,
Founder of Gladiator Games.

notes.title: Thank you.
notes.notes:
It's been exactly 1 year since I started development on Midnight at Forest. Around 3 months later on March 6th, the game was released. On the first week alone of release, we got over 1,000 downloads. And now we have over 13,000 downloads on the game. I'm so happy with these numbers and would like to thank all of you in this discord for this fantastic opportunity. 1 day before the release of Midnight at Forest, Ben and I guessed how many downloads we would get within the first week, Ben speculated 500, and I guessed 250. 

I know that 13,000 downloads in 9 months aren't much compared to big games, but it's so amazing for me.

I am trying to make the best game possible for all of you, but thank you all on my behalf of me and ben.

Thank you,
Rayne.

notes.title: Bug Fixes | Midnight at Forest 2 News
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Sorry for the lack of updates lately, this may be the last update before Midnight at Forest 2!
Let's get right into the patch notes before we give any hints about Midnight at Forest 2.

[list]
[*] Changed the Sprint Cooldown in Easy mode from 0s to 1s
[*] Fixed a glitch where you could still click buttons on the main menu while being in the loading screen
[*] Re-designed the loading screen
[/list]

I've also figured out that there's a speed glitch, but I've decided to keep it in the game because it's kind of funny.

[b][h1]Midnight at Forest 2[/h1][/b]
We've already planned a bit of Midnight at Forest 2, and we're gonna start working on it. This will include more than 95% of the assets being created by us (we may use unity assets). We don't want to give too many spoilers but it's gonna be amazing. I'll give you guys two words.

[h2]VR
Multiplayer[/h2]

Thank you!
Rayne,
Head Developer

notes.title: Midnight At Forest has been released
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

It is with great pleasure as I tell you that Midnight at Forest has officially been released. 
Please note you may experience bugs and we have already identified a few of them. If you experience any bugs that have not been fixed within 24-48 hours of release, please report a bug in our [url=https://discord.gg/nrFSp8VugF]discord[/url] or comment it in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1881690/discussions/]discussion page.[/url]

Please note that of course, this isn't the best game out there, and this is my (Rayne's) first ever 3d game. Feedback would be appreciated and don't be afraid to say any negative opinions about it.

Thanks for reading, and maybe playing,
Gladiator Games
